proof_id_hash.description: Hash of the proof whose disclosure consent was withdrawn.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the disclosure policy the withdrawn consent applied to.

sequence.description: One-based withdrawal sequence; the n-th withdrawal ever committed.

reason_code.description: Published reason code 1 to 4. Never reason text.

commitment_hash.description: Network- and registry-scoped consent withdrawal commitment.

description: Emitted when an issuer commits a hash-only record that disclosure consent for a proof and policy was withdrawn.
